requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The sole framework network door composes caller cancellation with the mandatory request deadline and bounds DNS resolution.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/egress.test.ts plus request-deadline.test.ts exercise transport policy and deadline abort behavior.

requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The framework-managed database provider wait is discarded when the request deadline expires and receives the deadline-bound Request signal.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/request-deadline.test.ts proves a hanging DB provider observes abort before handler progress.

requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The mutation transaction door rejects an expired request before opening work and rechecks inside the transaction callback before commit success.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/request-deadline.test.ts proves cooperative expiry takes the pre-commit rollback path and never records commit.

requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The owned deferred-render winner treats the mandatory request deadline as a timeout and revokes its retained render authority.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/deferred-region.test.ts and async-context confinement tests prove one-shot timeout and revocation behavior.

requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The sole response deadline wrapper errors and cancels an unfinished body stream and releases occupancy at deadline or completion.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/request-deadline.test.ts proves stream error, late discard, and occupancy reacquisition.

requestDeadlineEffectDoors.purpose: The Node adapter holds occupancy through actual response finish or close and destroys a slow response transport when its mandatory deadline expires.
requestDeadlineEffectDoors.evidence: packages/server/src/node.test.ts proves a stalled response transport is destroyed at deadline and the occupancy slot is reacquired.

principalEpochCredentialDoors.reason: Every principal-bound capability URL embeds the authoritative current epoch before signing.
The storage read and one-time replay burn stay unreachable until epoch freshness passes.
Every authenticated replay reservation identity embeds the authoritative current principal epoch.
A stored replay response is released only while its embedded principal epoch remains current.
Handler work stays unreachable unless the exact principal epoch that won the replay reservation remains current.
The app transaction cannot complete after an out-of-band epoch change; only its own exact declared transition receipt is accepted.
Replay settlement rechecks authoritative epoch freshness after handler completion before publishing durable response truth.
The exactly-once continuation is consumed and closed before its adapter frame returns; it is never a durable credential.
